title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As aSoftware Engineer, you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.Responsibilities
- Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.
- Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.
- Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review
- Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)
- Support production deployments
- Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.
- Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery
- Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.
- Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development
- Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.
- Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.
- Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification
- Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks
- Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software
- Effective verbal and written communication
- Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly
- Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed
- Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results
- Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work
- Parse, analyze and understand system log files
- Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels
- Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation
- Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills
- Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates
- Migration of platforms and application components.
- Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotationQualifications
- Technologist, Bachelor's or Master's Degree
- At least 7 years of Software Development experience
- Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.G. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)
- Java 17+
- Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)
- In memory caching like Hazelcast
- Oracle 12c
- XML, JSON
- Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA
- REST Services
- API Management frameworks
- General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle
- Jenkins, Sonar
- JIRA & Confluence
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues
- Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

Available Monday through Friday or 'staggered work week's, i.E. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Why Join Us? Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences

Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.E. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology. Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building. Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.Why Join JoVE?You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience5+ years of experience in delivery lead role Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment Working knowledge of:
- ETL processes and data pipelines
- BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectivelyNice to Have Skills & ExperienceExperience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environmentsJob DescriptionInsight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client's Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

Architecture & design support:Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches. Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA:Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes. CVE patching:Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments. no PoCs) Proven experience withquery optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines. Solid knowledge ofdistributed systems concepts(consistency, replication, failover, scaling) Hands-on experience withhigh availability and disaster recovery setups Comfort withLinux systems, networking basics and SQL. Ability toanalyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure(incident scenarios) Strong English language communication skills— able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing Bonus:Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM). Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.What we offer Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies atenterprise scale. Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities. Competitive salary Support for conference travel and OSS contributions Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.Location & working style Remote‐first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones. Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;

title: Product Designer
description: SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs. Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback. Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams. Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy. Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team. Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries. Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs).. Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team. Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.Required Skills 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role). Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture. A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design. Experience with Figma. Understand how modern technologies are used with design. Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked. Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas. Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements. Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work. Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem. Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniquesDesired Skills Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Prior experience in a design related role at a startup. Experience with digital health or relatable areas. Experience working with mobile apps.

The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description: About Us BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.What You'll Do As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.More specifically, in this role you will: Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs) Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updatesWhat We're Looking For 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta) 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients) Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationshipsWhat This Role Is NOT This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.Time Commitment Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.Pay $3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).Responsibilities and DutiesLead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;

partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;

Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.Essential SkillsExperience with Salesforce development;
Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. title: Engenheiro De Vendas Sênior
description: ENGENHEIRO DE VENDAS TÉCNICAS – ELÉTRICA DE ALTA PERFORMANCE Se você é um engenheiro que domina o campo técnico, entende profundamente ensaios elétricos e sabe transformar conhecimento em resultados comerciais expressivos, esta oportunidade foi desenhada para você. Você atuará em vendas consultivas técnicas de alto impacto para setor de energia do Brasil Terá autonomia para negociar, propor e fechar Seu conhecimento técnico será valorizado, não subutilizado O crescimento financeiro acompanha sua performance Ambiente profissional, técnico e orientado a resultadosSe você já construiu autoridade técnica, se domina ensaios elétricos com profundidade, e sente que pode ganhar mais entregando mais valor, esta vaga foi criada para o seu próximo nível profissional. Profissionais medianos se candidatam. Especialistas de alto nível se posicionam.Sobre a Highmed A Highmed é uma empresa brasileira especializada no desenvolvimento, comercialização e suporte de equipamentos de alta precisão para medição, teste e diagnóstico. Com uma trajetória de excelência no mercado nacional, nos destacamos pela qualidade e confiabilidade de nossos produtos, que atendem às mais rigorosas normas e padrões internacionais.Nosso portfólio abrangente inclui soluções inovadoras para ensaios elétricos, termografia, mecânica, segurança no trabalho e teste e medição, atendendo diversos setores como energia, telecomunicações, indústria, construção civil e instituições de pesquisa. Cada produto Highmed é resultado de um compromisso contínuo com a inovação tecnológica e a satisfação dos clientes.Com uma equipe de profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecemos não apenas equipamentos de ponta, mas soluções completas que incluem treinamento, calibração e suporte técnico especializado.Nossa missão é proporcionar a nossos clientes a segurança e precisão necessárias em suas medições, contribuindo para a excelência de seus processos e resultados.

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:
Quem somos nós?Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica paraescalar resultadose aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção desoluções inovadorase disruptivas emmais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionaisde múltiplos segmentos.Nosso propósito éimpactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos umespaço aberto e livrepara você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas egerar mudanças ao seu redor .Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:Contratação:CLT Modelo de Trabalho:Remoto Horário:das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. Etapas do Processo:Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação:Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.O que buscamos?Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.Como será seu dia-a-dia?Liderança técnica:Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
Compreensão do fluxo devalor:Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
Colaboração com equipesmultifuncionais:Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas:Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Planejamento e design técnico:Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
Entrega contínua de valor:Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas;
Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe:Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos;
Medição e melhoria de resultados:Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas;
Comunicação e apresentação de resultados:Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais;
Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC;
Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
Domínio em automação detestes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Analista De Relações Com Investidores E Esg Iii
description:

Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado daB3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade. Apoiar na elaboração derelatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;

Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.Informações adicionais O que nós oferecemos:Vale Alimentação Vale Refeição Assistência Médica Assistência odontológica Participação nos Resultados Wellhub Zenklub Espaço de descompressão equipado com vídeo games, ping pong e espaço para alimentaçãoOnde estamos: Faria Lima - SP

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. title: Research Engineer, Rl Environments
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, RL Environmentsto help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.What You'll Do: 1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria. Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals. Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming. Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions. Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring. Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities. Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift. When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure. Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.2. Highly valued experience Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods. Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems. Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis. Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints. Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.Key Responsibilities Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights. Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI. Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
ensure usability, consistency, and performance. Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows. Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement. Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
monitor performance anditerate based on feedback. Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas. Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python. Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation. Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages). Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming). Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing). Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus. Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.Tech Stack (Indicative) Languages: Java, Python, C++ Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows) Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
CI/CD pipelines Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuningWhat We're Looking For Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset. Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs. Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope TheFreight Desk Manageris a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on theLATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion:Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Rate Card Governance:Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cardsacross a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing:Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiativesfor logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture:Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight:Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering:Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management:Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience:Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise:Deep knowledge of theLATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery:Proven track record inleading RFQsand managing complexlogistics supplier onboardingprocesses. Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education:MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence:Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation:Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background:Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;

title: Sap S/4 Hana Brim Application Expert
description: ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams. Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging. Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting). Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities. Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA Essential: Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries. Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA. Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles. Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology. Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated. Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable: SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM. Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions. Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS Office based/Remote with occasional international travel. Health and Safety accountability statements. Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.We are the ASSA ABLOY Group Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.Required Skills & Experience - 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness. - Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting. - Hands-on experience with API testing (e.G., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%). - Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.Nice to Have Skills & Experience - Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms. - Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable). - Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).Day to Day - Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support. - Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines. - Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. - Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution. - Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar;
validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors. - Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness. - Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Senior Database Administrator — Oltp & Olap Databases
description: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP DatabasesLocation: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement. This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.What You'll Own OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaborationTech Stack OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ) OLAP: ClickHouse 25.X CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)Requirements 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication) Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systemsNice to Have Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2) Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.Benefits: Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description: Summary of Job DutiesEnsure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of: Customer development Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation. Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer's need Customer relationship management Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA's marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD Marketing service: Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-salesMain ResponsibilitiesAlthough the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:Market Research To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as: Customer Survey Analysis Customer service needs/opportunities Customer's org chart Customer's end consumer insights and trends Prospects and opportunity analysis Category Analysis Sales Channels Competitive landscapeMarketing Support Service Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution Market Research/Business Intelligence Receipe support `zSales distributionAccount Based Marketing Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered: Identify high-value target accounts –Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company. Conduct research on those accounts- Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey. Develop customized marketing campaigns- Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account. Run customized marketing campaigns- Launch your campaigns to the target account. Measure customized marketing campaigns- Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.Online Marketing Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region. Webinars SEO –Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage Social media– Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based Email marketing– Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.Offline Marketing Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover Exhibitions Roadshows Print (Quarterly updates) PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)Public Relations Build up media relations and 'Distribution Media List' for future press release distribution in their assigned region. Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)Master's degree in a Marketing related discipline. Around 10 years of experience Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.Skills NeededMarket Research and Analysis:The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends. Strategic Planning:Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans. Team Leadership and Management:Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration:Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations. Brand Management:They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience. Campaign Management:This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns. Budget Management:Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently. Data Analysis and Interpretation:Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions. Communication Skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners. Adaptability and Flexibility:The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success. Problem-Solving Skills:Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically. Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity:Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets. Time Management:Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment. Tech-Savviness:Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently. Negotiation Skills:The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Application Security Engineer
description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ yearsof experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and proceduresRequired Experience: Excellent English communication skills 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10 Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.G., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.) Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineersDesired Experience: University degree or relevant industry experience Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with cloud security principles Experience with secure architecture reviews Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP Experience working in agile development environmentsAdditional Information: Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
